# Monoes

> Monoes builds open-source AI agent tools (Monomind, Mono Agent, MonoClip, MonoTask) and runs Monoes Workforce, a managed service that deploys AI digital workers to automate business processes end-to-end on the ERP, CRM and email systems a company already uses.

Monoes offers two paths on one engine: self-host the open-source tools for free, or hire Monoes Workforce to design, deploy and monitor digital workers for you. Founded by Morteza Nokhodian, author of Monomind. Contact: hello@monoes.me. Security: security@monoes.me.

## Monoes Workforce (managed agentic process automation)

- [Workforce overview](https://monoes.me/workforce): AI digital workers that execute business processes end-to-end on your existing ERP, CRM, email, Excel/CSV, accounting and ticketing systems.
- [How it works](https://monoes.me/workforce/how-it-works): each worker = deterministic Workflow + AI Agent (reads, extracts, decides within a step) + versioned Policy rules (e.g. "invoices over $20,000 require approval") + swappable Connectors. Five autonomy levels, from manual to autonomous exception handling; workers start with human approval.
- [Capabilities](https://monoes.me/workforce/capabilities): workers for finance and accounting (AP, AR, reconciliation, period close), procurement (3-way match, PO tracking), HR (onboarding, payroll support), customer service (ticket triage, SLA monitoring), sales and CRM (lead follow-up, quote-to-order), and reporting.
- Pricing: Discovery audit $3,000 (1 day, one process) or $12,000 (5 days, multi-department). Typical pilots start at $15,000 with a fixed, itemized quote. Engagement: Discovery 1-5 days, Pilot 3-6 weeks, Expand 1-3 months, then Scale.

## Open-source products

- [Monomind](https://monoes.me/projects/monomind): open-source (Apache 2.0) TypeScript CLI and MCP server that adds a local codebase knowledge graph, persistent local SQLite memory with local embeddings, document search, multi-agent coordination and policy-gated background agent orgs to AI coding assistants (Claude Code, OpenCode, Antigravity, Kimi Code, Codex). Install: `npm install -g monomind`. Source: https://github.com/monoes/monomind
- [Mono Agent](https://monoes.me/projects/mono-agent): open-source (MIT), local-first n8n alternative in a single Go binary - 100+ workflow node types, visual DAG editor and desktop app, built-in human-in-the-loop approval, encrypted secrets vault in the OS keychain, and an MCP server so AI agents can build and run workflows. Source: https://github.com/monoes/mono-agent
- [MonoClip](https://monoes.me/projects/mono-clip): a clipboard manager with memory.
- [MonoTask](https://monoes.me/projects/monotask): peer-to-peer kanban board with no server and no account.
